content: Official Transbank WooCommerce plugin CommitWebpayController (authoritative real-world discriminator): reads POST body or GET query (token_ws, TBK_TOKEN, TBK_ID_SESION, TBK_ORDEN_COMPRA); branch order: token_ws+TBK_TOKEN=ERROR_FLOW; TBK_ID_SESION+TBK_TOKEN+no token_ws=ABORTED; TBK_ID_SESION only=TIMEOUT (lookup by TBK_ORDEN_COMPRA/buy_order); token_ws only=NORMAL (commit). checkIsAlreadyProcessed(token) guard prevents double processing on refresh. Approved via commitResponse->isApproved(). Ends with wp_redirect (302) to order-received URL. Exceptions taxonomy: AlreadyProcesseded/DoubleToken/Timeout/UserCancel/RejectedCommit.
